en: Welcome,
Have a drink with me. That's why you came, right?
Or did you come to sweet-talk my missus?
You're welcome here any time.
All the more if you bring some pricey liquor.
Welcome. Drink up, go on, have a drink.
Wouldn't be right, me drinking alone.
Have a drink.
You sure can hold your liquor.
Seems I'm the only one drinking.
Hey, welcome.
This is the liquor shop. I'm Scott.
You seem well soused already, shopkeeper.
No fancy liquor here of the sort you'd buy,
but there's plenty of the kind I like.
It's my shop, after all.
Huh? You're the one who came to my place.
note: Worded so the player's 'Yes, I am {NAME}.' (#396 variant + #2919) can answer it.

en: It might not suit your taste, but
buy some liquor off me, eh? Some liquor!
Or you could drink it here.
note: Trailing space: #3461 follows on the same line.

en: And spare me a drop or two, eh?
Yet you seem to have only cheap liquor here.
Well, sure.
Folks like us can't afford to drink
much better than this, see.
Oh, staying for a drink?
Hey, you're back again, eh?
Wanna drink after all, I bet. Who wouldn't?
I mean, I drink even on the job.
Say, I hear you've been wandering around
here on business.
My missus was telling me all sorts.
Mind you, nothing's less reliable
than her gossip.
If you're saying you work while
my shop's open,
you're welcome to come when it's closed.
But bring some liquor when you do.
Why do women have to be such
nags, eh?
Well, by women I mean my missus and the old
gal who comes to drink, that's all.
Hmph. You were no use to humankind,
note: Stern player after drinking blood (servant mode).

en: so devote yourself to me instead.
Just as I thought... a vulgar taste.
Hello. What are you doing?
Huh?
If this looks like anything but drinking,
I'd like to hear it.
Well, you seem to be drinking a lot,
so I wondered if it was a celebration.
Don't need a reason to drink.
If folks only drank on happy occasions,
I'd be out of business.
Come when the shop's open.
I'll pour you a drink.
That's my trade, after all.
You come round a lot, don't ya.
Next time, bring some liquor, will ya?
When I'm open, it's all going out,
so when I'm shut, you gotta bring some in,
or it don't even out.
Did you bring me some liquor?
Be a pal
You sure can hold your drink.
This is the liquor shop. Having a drink?
No, I'm just stopping by for a moment.
That won't do. You're missing half of life.
Though for a fine-looking fella like you,
I bet the other half's plenty.
note: The other half of life = women (see #3524/#3525).

en: Oh, so you're in the mood for a drink?
Or is it a celebration?
Come to think of it, I don't know your name.
That's right.
I'm
note: Before the name; #452 '.' follows. Also used by msg 320994 (Samantha scene).

en: So, d'you know my name?
No, I don't believe I've heard it.
That's right, my name's a secret.
I'm Secret Scott.
note: Joke: he gives his name away while calling it secret (#3522 'How'd he know my name?').
